title: Plus One
summary: The digits describe a nonnegative decimal integer from most to least significant.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100 digits in [0,9]. Leading zeros are forbidden except for [0].

statement: The digits describe a nonnegative decimal integer from most to least significant. Return the digit array for that integer increased by one.

examples.explanation: The result needs an extra digit.

constraints: 1–100 digits in [0,9]. Leading zeros are forbidden except for [0].
hints: Conceptual: Only a carry can affect an earlier digit.
Directional: Work from the last digit toward the first.
Implementation: Turn trailing 9s into zeros. Increment the next digit, or add a leading 1 when every digit was 9.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) space including the result copy.
